scripts.text:
[Belka]
Welcome to Zonda, where innovation begins. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
欢迎来到宗达，创新由此开始。请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: Enter ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Forest>^000000.
Enter ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Sky>^000000.
Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Request entry.
scripts.translation: 申请入场

scripts.text:
[Belka]
We now offer a new service. Have you heard about the dimensional rifts?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
我们现在提供一项新服务。您听说过次元裂缝吗？

scripts.text:
[Belka]
In case you haven't, many organizations and scientists study the rifts formed between dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
或许您还不知道，许多组织和科学家都在研究次元之间形成的裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
One of them is my company, Zonda, and after long, painstaking research...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
我们宗达公司也不例外，经过漫长而艰苦的研究...

scripts.text:
[Belka]
We've developed two different dimensional rifts that we call Wave Modes - Forest and Sky!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
我们开发出了两种不同的次元裂缝，称为波浪模式——森林和天空！

scripts.text:
[Belka]
Do you have any questions about Zonda's ambitious new project, Wave Mode?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
您对宗达雄心勃勃的新项目“波浪模式”有任何疑问吗？

scripts.text: About ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Forest>^000000
About ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Sky>^000000
No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Belka]
The ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Forest>^000000
Introducing the first Wave Mode service, Zonda's objective is to work with your party members to keep monster waves from reaching the other side of the bridge.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
^6B9900<波浪模式 - 森林>^000000
这是宗达推出的首个波浪模式服务。
您需要与队员合作，阻止一波波魔物抵达桥的另一端。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
Monsters will advance without fighting, but the party will fail if 20 monsters are let go..
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
魔物只会向前推进，不会还击。
不过，一旦放走20只，队伍就会挑战失败。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
The ^6B9900<Wave Mode - Sky>^000000
Available once a day. Like the other Wave Mode, keep the monsters away from reaching the other side of the map.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
^6B9900<波浪模式 - 天空>^000000
每天可进入一次。
和另一种波浪模式相同，要阻止魔物抵达地图的另一端。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
Feel free to come back with your party.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
欢迎随时带着您的队伍回来。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
Thank you for visiting Zonda, where innovation begins.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
感谢您光临宗达，这里是创新的起点。

scripts.text:
[Belka]
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔卡]
还有其他问题吗？
